posts.name: JaviC
posts.cooked:
I think the view is clear, Winnie the Pooh said that chinese AI companies have to keep releasing open source models. The competition for them is seeing Deepseek release the july update and Qwen announce the Qwen-122 release, so they just put it out.

This means 3 things:

  1. Stuff will be broken at first because they rushed to beat Alibaba
  2. Models are now going to be geared essentially for our setup, VRAM wise
  3. Capitalism is awesome for some things. Definitely for AI!
